question: Due to a reduction of 6.25% in the price of sugar, a man can buy 1 kg more for Rs. 120. The reduced price per kg of sugar is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find the reduced price directly, we can use the fractional equivalent of the given percentage.

Reduced Price = (Fraction of Reduction × Amount) ÷ Extra Quantity

⇒ Fraction value of 6.25% = 1/16

⇒ Reduced Price = (1/16 × 120) ÷ 1

⇒ Reduced Price = 120 ÷ 16 = 7.5

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 7.5.**
